column3: Close to the Hebrew; תַּנִּינִים (“sea monsters”) is rendered “great sea creatures.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְקִיטוֹר (“smoke, mist”) is rendered “clouds.”
Close to the Hebrew; “rulers” is rendered “judges.”
Close to the Hebrew; עִם־ נְעָרִים (“with youths”) is rendered “children.”
Close to the Hebrew; “his godly ones” is rendered “His saints,” and “a people of his kin” “A people near to Him.”
